subject: Transition rally — Clarion Health activation owners, timeline & open risks
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sanjay Reddy <s.reddy@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Claire Mills <claire.mills@clarionhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Transition rally — Clarion Health activation owners, timeline & open risks

Team / Sanjay / Claire,

Thanks again for the trust — Clarion’s signed and we’ve got a tight go-live target (pilot rollout begins 2029-10-15). This thread is the transition "rally" I promised: concise summary, owners, timeline, and three current risks we need eyes on. Please read and confirm owners by EOD tomorrow so we can lock the MAP and SOW next week.

Deal summary (tldr):
- Product: Redwood Hosted inference + dedicated routing for PHI subsets
- Initial scope: 3 production models (chat + embeddings), prefix cache enabled, 2-week pilot (50k tokens/day avg)
- Commercials: Annual commitment + 6-month ramp credit (see attached SOW_Draft_v1.docx)

Primary asks for CS handoff:
1) Primary CS owner for day-to-day onboarding and weekly syncs (Monica listed below)
2) Technical POC from Clarion (Sanjay confirmed Claire as engineering lead)
3) Acceptance checklist and pilot success metrics (see MAP)

Owners (proposed):
- Sales sponsor / exec escalation: Marissa Cole (me)
- CS lead (onboarding + adoption): Monica Patel (please confirm)
- Integration / platform contact: Claire Mills (Clarion) / Sanjay Reddy (ops)
- Solutions engineering touch (pre-GoLive): Naomi Feldman (burn-down on infra knobs)

Key dates / milestones:
- 2029-08-05: Mutual Action Plan finalization (internal sign-off) [attachment: Clarion_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx]
- 2029-08-12: Kickoff w/ Clarion (technical deep-dive)
- 2029-09-20: Pilot readiness checklist complete
- 2029-10-15: Pilot begins

Open risks (priority):
A) Data residency clarification for audit logs — Clarion needs SOC-style access pattern; legal is still reviewing retention settings. Impact: may change where we store trace logs and require additional KMS setup.
B) Integration windows — Clarion’s infra team has two blackout weeks in September (9/5–9/19) that may compress the prepilot window.
C) Model quantization tradeoffs — we recommended int8 for cost; Clarion wants parity testing against float32 for QA. Will need extra perf runs.

Attachments: Clarion_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (MAP v0.3), SOW_Draft_v1.docx

Next steps: Monica — can you confirm you own the onboarding, and if so, pick an initial weekly cadence? Naomi — are you available for the 8/12 tech deep-dive? Sanjay/Claire — please confirm the blackout window and whether Clarion legal needs any additional artifacts for the retention/KMS ask.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | m: 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: Transition rally — Clarion Health activation owners, timeline & open risks

Marissa / Monica,

Appreciate the succinct plan — Claire and I reviewed and yes, pilot target (10/15) still stands on our side. A few clarifications from Clarion:
- The blackout window is 2029-09-05 through 2029-09-19 (confirmed) — we can move some infra prep earlier in August.
- For audit logs: legal wants a short summary of what data appears in traces (PII? hashed IDs?) and whether logs can be TTL’d to 90 days. I’ll paste the legal contact on a follow-up if needed.
- Claire will be the primary technical lead; she asked that Naomi get access to a staging cluster the week of 8/19 for perf profiling.

We’ll respond to the MAP with a single-sheet comment doc by 8/05.

— Sanjay

Thanks Marissa — I’ll take point as CS lead for onboarding and weekly cadence. Proposed initial plan:
- Weekly sync cadence: Tuesdays 10:00 AM PT starting 2029-08-13 (45m)
- Initial kickoff agenda (8/12): Introductions, success metrics, infra constraints, access matrix, MAP review
- Monica deliverables before 8/05: final MAP comments consolidated + acceptance criteria draft for pilot

Naomi — can you confirm staging cluster access for the week of 8/19 and a short perf run window (2–3 hours)? Karthik — I may need a short buffer for SOW approval if legal asks for edits; can you stand by for a quick sign-off if needed?

I’ll create a shared deployment checklist in Drive and link in the MAP once I have Clarion’s comments.

Monica Patel

Quick notes on the three risks:
- Audit logs: we can provide a log extract schema and a config to TTL to 90d; will need Clarion legal contact to sign off on data handling.
- Blackout window: we’ll aim to complete integration steps before 9/05; will push heavier kernel tuning to the 8/20 perf window.
- Quantization testing: Naomi will run float32 vs int8 parity tests during perf window and capture delta on latency/accuracy — can share a short memo by 8/22.

If everyone is aligned I’ll add the perf memo and ticket links to the MAP.
